**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve structured seam errors on non-2xx responses**

This early `!response.ok` return regresses error fidelity for the chat seam: the API pipeline intentionally returns contract-shaped `Result` errors (with specific codes like `CHAT_INPUT_INVALID` / `CHAT_SPEC_INVALID` and optional `details`) even when HTTP status is 400/422/502, so callers could previously distinguish validation failures from upstream/provider failures by parsing the body. With this guard, all non-2xx responses are collapsed into `CHAT_HTTP_ERROR`, losing those actionable codes and details from `runChatInterpretationPipeline`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
